---
title: "Major League Baseball History"
---

Welcome! This site explores the history of Major League Baseball using Sean Lahman's historical baseball database. By analyzing team and player statistics across more than a century of baseball, we investigate how offensive power has evolved over time.

Our analysis reveals that apparent historical "collapses" in total home runs were often artifacts of shortened seasons—such as the strikes of 1981 and 1994 or the pandemic season of 2020—rather than true drops in power, as home runs per game followed normal historical trends. In addition, we examine the game's all-time career home run leaders, the heavy presence of the steroid era among the top sluggers, and the peak seasons of home run king Barry Bonds.

Use the **Home runs** and **Sluggers** links in the navigation bar above to explore the full analysis.
